WHOLE_BATCH.semantics: Observe every pulse in the sorted external timeline, then poll once through the common final horizon.

MIDPOINT_TWO_BATCH.semantics: Split at the pulse-index midpoint, moving the boundary right until an equal-timestamp group is not split. Within each API batch, observe all pulses before polling. For the first batch poll only through that batch's terminal external timestamp; after the second batch poll through the common final horizon. This freezes call-boundary grouping without introducing a different inter-batch settle duration.

EVENT_TIME_CAUSAL.semantics: Group equal-timestamp pulses; before observing each timestamp group poll through that external timestamp, then observe the group; after all groups poll through the common final horizon.

isolation_replay.rule: Derive omission schedules before downstream replay. For each arm replay the identical external pulses plus only that arm's omission pulses through a fresh v0.4 brain.
isolation_replay.attribution: downstream differences are attributable to omission-schedule differences rather than expectation training or plasticity history

outcome_map.NO_BATCH_PARTITION_EFFECT: Both timeline families have identical omission schedules across all three arms and identical downstream replay observables.
outcome_map.SCHEDULER_ONLY_PARTITION_EFFECT: At least one family has an omission-schedule difference, and every family with a schedule difference has identical downstream replay observables across arms.
outcome_map.FUNCTIONAL_BATCH_PARTITION_EFFECT: At least one family has an omission-schedule difference and at least one such family has a downstream replay-observable difference across arms.
outcome_map.MIXED: Deterministic results do not fit the three clean cases or contain an unexpected downstream difference without an omission-schedule difference.
